Re: Request for review of the out-of-school suspension of [Student first name], grade [X], issued September 21, 2026

Dear [Principal name]:

I am the parent or guardian of [Student first name]. I am writing to request a review of the 2-school-day out-of-school suspension issued on September 21, 2026, as provided under 105 ILCS 5/10-22.6(b), and to request the complete written suspension decision.

I have not received any written notice of this suspension, so I have not been told the reasons for the suspension, the specific act of gross disobedience or misconduct, or the rationale for the length of the suspension. Each of these must appear in the written decision under 105 ILCS 5/10-22.6(b). Please provide a complete written decision that includes them.

Please also state in writing whether the school found that [Student first name]'s continuing presence in school posed a threat to safety or a disruption, as 105 ILCS 5/10-22.6 requires before an out-of-school suspension, and the facts that finding rests on.

I also request copies of [Student first name]'s school student records related to this incident, including the referral, any statements, and any record of interventions, under the Illinois School Student Records Act (105 ILCS 10/5).

Please confirm in writing that [Student first name] will be permitted to make up all missed work for equivalent academic credit under 105 ILCS 5/10-22.6(b-30).

Please confirm the date of the review and send the requested documents to me at the address or email below.

Sincerely,

[Parent or guardian name]
